entities.name: Coernn
entities.description: A pale young sorcerer of the Dark Age on Terisiare, secretly sent by Apepei, who died fighting Sacumon.

entities.name: Apepei
entities.description: Sent Coernn secretly to find Yunnie.

entities.name: Yunnie
entities.description: Prophesied inheritor of the Sigil of Iwset, raised by minotaurs.

entities.name: Maeveen O'Donagh
entities.description: A captain who saved Yunnie's life; unaware of Coernn's real allegiance.

entities.name: Vervamon
entities.description: Companion of Coernn who refused to turn away from the City of Shadows until exposed to prophetic dreams.

entities.name: Quopomma
entities.description: Large warrior Coernn stood his ground against.

entities.name: Sacumon
entities.description: Sorceress with blood magic killed in the caves of the Niroso.

entities.name: Sigil of Iwset
entities.description: Item Yunnie is prophesied to inherit.

entities.name: City of Shadows
entities.description: Place where the party spent a night and had prophetic dreams.

entities.name: Merfolk Vista
entities.description: Cliff where Yunnie nearly jumped to his death.

entities.name: Urhaalan Valley
entities.description: Valley where Yunnie's minotaur tribe warred with elves.

entities.name: Eln Forest
entities.description: Forest of the elves at war with the minotaurs.

events.summary: Apepei secretly sends Coernn to track down Yunnie, inheritor of the Sigil of Iwset.
events.quote: Coernn was secretly sent by Apepei to track down

events.summary: Coernn scries that Yunnie will appear at Shingol; after a night of prophetic dreams in the City of Shadows Vervamon agrees to go there.
events.quote: Vervamon agreed to turn back and travel to Shingol

events.summary: Maeveen saves Yunnie as he is about to jump from Merfolk Vista.
events.quote: the quick-acting captain saved Yunnie's life

events.summary: The group joins Yunnie and travels north to Urhaalan Valley, where his adopted minotaur tribe is at war with the elves.
events.quote: Yunnie led them all north to

events.summary: In the caves of the Niroso Coernn deflects Sacumon's spells and she is killed, but a coal golem burns Coernn to death.
events.quote: Coernn was caught in the grip of a coal golem and burned to death in its fiery embrace

relations.quote: Coernn was secretly sent by Apepei
they faced off against the sorceress Sacumon
